scope: CPU-only saved-score Phase0b; no measured scores analyzed and no repository edits
integration_notes: Copy driver into E20/expt_v1 before beginning a real output directory: script path/hash are pinned.
Use --scores <phase0_cells_e20.csv> --out <results/phase0b> --freeze-dir <expt_v1/forecasts> --workers 4; --phase strict is a resumable early stage, --phase all completes graded/dimensionality.
Primary remains 11-system panel plus start policy; both E05 sensitivity results and exact parameter/forecast differences are reported; no favorable-G0 substitution.
Numerical G0 is unavailable if either prespecified 2PL family cannot be compared under the convergence gate; a descriptive features-only or1PL failure does not gate primary.
Two-skill heldout log score uses the strict/category joint predictive probability, not sum of separately integrated marginal log probabilities.
Ordinal nonconstant-category forecast is a lower bound for exact reward variation; ability-scale first threshold is -cut/b, with literal cut correlations also reported.
H1-H4 treatment-effect numeric forecasts are not invented; frozen payload documents they would need a separate pretraining registration if training were reauthorized.
Existing helper correction patch is optional for this driver because its own checked/cached CV and G0 replace those helpers.
